summary: Frontend-only verification of ACID one-page site after supervisor infra fix (directory=/app, yarn dev on port 3000). All 5 acceptance criteria pass: (1) home renders with nav + hero H1 'Cine que vende.', (2) all 3 routes return HTTP 200 and render correct H1s, (3) all 4 nav anchor links update URL hash and target existing sections, (4) EN toggle switches hero to 'Film that sells.' and ES restores Spanish, (5) no JS runtime/render errors in console.

issues: 10 static asset 404s observed in browser console (likely favicon/images/fonts). Non-blocking to rendering but should be cleaned up to avoid noise.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Site works at http://localhost:3000. Test anchor links at desktop viewport (>=1440) — they are hidden by CSS at <=820px by design. Language toggle uses buttons with exact text 'ES' and 'EN' in top-right.

Fix (already applied by main agent): supervisor config now uses directory=/app and command 'yarn dev' on PORT=3000. Verified: HTTP 200 for /, /aviso-de-privacidad, /aviso-legal and full content renders.
